arguments.assumptions: Explicit hypothetical FY2026 US-GAAP diluted EPS and P/E sensitivity, not consensus, a target, or an observed multiple. FY2026 is a 53-week year with a 14-week Q4; $41.40 nine-month GAAP diluted EPS is the reported anchor. Bear/base/bull annual EPS of $70.00/$72.13/$74.00 imply Q4 residual EPS of $28.60/$30.73/$32.60 under a constant diluted-share approximation. The base residual equals Micron's GAAP Q4 EPS midpoint guidance of $30.73 (+/- $1.00); bear is below guidance and tests a demand/margin or execution miss, while bull is above guidance and tests sustained AI-memory demand and margin strength. P/E stress assumptions of 11x/14x/17x test cycle-sensitive compression/expansion without empirical probability, fair-value claim, or historical-multiple claim. No forward diluted-share count is supplied.

cases.rationale: Hypothesis: Q4 residual EPS of $28.60 falls below the $29.73-$31.73 GAAP guidance interval as demand, pricing/mix, or margin execution weakens; pair with multiple compression.
Hypothesis: Q4 residual EPS equals the $30.73 GAAP guidance midpoint, supported by AI-memory product demand and guided operating structure; multiple is an explicit held-fixed stress assumption.
Hypothesis: Q4 residual EPS of $32.60 exceeds guidance as AI-memory demand and margins remain stronger than guided; pair with multiple expansion.
